estimates.assumptions: Standard edible portion for 4 bone-in chicken legs (thighs+drumsticks) is ~250g each after estimating typical sizes; full raw weight including bone/skin used as recipe adds them whole and calories match skin-on raw chicken leg data.

One chicken stock cube weighs ~4g; calories per 100g left null as it is a dehydrated concentrate whose contribution is negligible when dissolved and no standard per-100g value applies directly to the cube itself.
'Chopped' parsley is a modest garnish amount for the whole recipe (typical 2-3 tbsp chopped leaves); uses supplied knownCaloriesPer100g.
